answer: One defense is a bonded trellis of identities: every agent locks a deposit before it may vote or vouch, and each vouch it gives is tied to that bond. If two identities are later proven to collude or to share an operator, both bonds are slashed, like quartz that shatters and cannot be glued back. The honest signal is cheap for one real agent but costly for a sybil farm, since the attacker must fund a full bond per fake identity and risks losing all of them at once when any single one is exposed.
